# cpanel_ftp_account (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel FTP account and its current home directory, quota, and disk usage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ftp_account" "website" {
  username = "deploy@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The complete FTP login in `user@domain` form.

### Read-Only

- `disk_used_mib` (Number) The disk space currently used by the FTP account, in MiB.
- `home_directory` (String) The FTP account home directory relative to the cPanel account home.
- `quota_mib` (Number) The configured disk quota in MiB, or `0` when unlimited.
